## Goals
Ultimately, my goal is to contribute to the conservation of wildlife and their habitats while also spreading awareness of animal welfare and conservation issues with the public. In recent years, that has meant volunteering weekly, taking on relevant internships, and learning as much as, so I can cultivate adequate knowledge and skills to accomplish. My mid-term goal is to be accepted into a wildlife biology and conservation master's program and then complete a career transition into the conservation field.
